company_name: Sichuan Hongxin FFKM Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company produces FFKM seals used in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Sichuan Hongxin FFKM Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing perfluoroether rubber products, including FFKM seals such as O-rings and gaskets. These products are designed for harsh operating conditions and are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing, among other industries.
